title: Extract tool execution, handoff, background task, and sandbox capability boundaries
description: AstrBot's FunctionToolExecutor combines local tool calls, MCP tools, handoff agents, background tasks, result wake-up, and sandbox capability checks. Rust plugin/tool work should define these as typed tool execution boundaries instead of growing plugin SDK or pipeline stages directly.

files.change: Expose typed tool declarations without binding to one executor implementation.
Separate local tool execution from pipeline and handler registry concerns.
Connect tool execution to SandboxProfile/ToolCapability decisions before running a tool.

criteria: Tool capability checks are reusable by plugin execution and future agent/tool-call orchestration.
Pipeline stages depend on traits, not concrete tool execution internals.
Background and handoff task semantics are planned separately from immediate plugin handler dispatch.
convergence.verification_command: cargo test -p astrbot-plugin && cargo test -p astrbot-pipeline && cargo test --workspace
